role_resolution_model.principle: Canonical control role identity is resolved deterministically by counting all bindings of that role among listed Issue comments. Role identity is independent from comment recency. No latest/newest/first/ID heuristic.

cardinality_rules.meaning: required role: not found / missing role -> CONTROL_ROLE_MISSING fail closed, no mutation; optional runtime_activation_record: absent unless explicitly authorized (not a failure outside activation context)
deterministic target -> exact resolved comment ID + revision + digest is the single mutation target; update in place

conflict / reconciliation required -> CONTROL_ROLE_DUPLICATE fail closed; no mutation; no silent preference selection among duplicates; must reconcile deterministically or surface CONFLICT for LLM/user

canonical_roles.zero_behavior: CONTROL_ROLE_MISSING fail closed; no Issue body or control comment mutation until reconciled
canonical_roles.one_behavior: update canonical control comment in place (strict: read exact current raw object -> validate precondition -> update exact comment ID -> readback verify)
canonical_roles.many_behavior: CONTROL_ROLE_DUPLICATE fail closed; surface CONFLICT; no newest/latest selection; no duplicate creation
canonical_roles.role_identity_source: deterministic marker extracted from comment body (e.g., fixed header token), not comment recency

canonical_roles.zero_behavior: absent unless explicitly authorized runtime/deployment lifecycle requires it; M4 source does not activate runtime (D10) so creation is generally not required
canonical_roles.one_behavior: resolve when authorized operation requires it; update in place

canonical_roles.zero_behavior: empty log is valid; append first evidence comment on authorized append-only operation
canonical_roles.one_behavior: not applicable (append-only grows; read for monotonicity only)
canonical_roles.many_behavior: many entries expected historically; append-only does not use role-cardinality duplicate rule; duplicate detection is via idempotent correlation/attempt, not count heuristic

update_in_place_rule.existing_canonical_role_target_behavior: update in place (single bounded authorized write to the exact resolved comment ID)
update_in_place_rule.implementation_note: GitHub adapter must read current role target before any write; if binding count==1, mutate that exact comment ID with its current raw revision precondition; if count 0 or >1, fail closed before any external write.

no_latest_comment_heuristic_guarantee.verification: M4-6 tests will assert duplicate role surfaces CONFLICT, not silently prefers latest
